name: claude-code-companion
description: Copilot-style indicators for Claude Code: model, mode, effort, and usage limits in the status bar, with quick pickers.

claudeCompanion.showModel.description: Show the model indicator in the status bar.

claudeCompanion.showEffort.description: Show the effort-level indicator in the status bar.

claudeCompanion.showMode.description: Show the session permission-mode indicator in the status bar.

claudeCompanion.showUsage.description: Show the usage-limits indicator in the status bar.

claudeCompanion.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to re-check Claude Code's config and session files for changes.

claudeCompanion.usageWarningPercent.description: Usage percentage at which the indicator turns to warning color.

claudeCompanion.usageErrorPercent.description: Usage percentage at which the indicator turns to error color.
